main_text.l: lib.2.de Spiritu sancto. Epiphan. hær. 69. contra Ariomanitas.& hæres 48.cont.Montanist.

II. Est Jehova : quia quæ Jehovæ tribuun-tur in Scriptura : etiam Spiritui sancto conveniunt. Jef. 6. Jehova dixit: vade & dic populo huic,&c: Actor.28.Bene Spiritus sanctus locutus est per,&c.Psal.95.Heb.3. Sicut dicit Spiritus sanctus. Hodie si, &c. At Jehova gloriam suam alteri non dat.Jef.4.

III. Nec non & illud considerandum, quod in corde & sensu habitare non potest creatura, nisi Deus & fermo ejus in Spiritu sancto. De patre. Levit.26. Inhabitabo in illis. De Filio. Eph.3. De Spiritu S.1.Cor.6.&2.Cor.6.
IV. Una est fides in P.F.& Spiritu S. Eph.4.5.
V. Unus & perfectus Baptismus est in nomine P.F.& S.S.Matt.28.Eph.4.

VI. Est verus Deus, qui non est nisi unus: Act.5. Non hominibus sed Deo mentitus es:1.Cor.6. Estis templum Dei: Act.4. Creator cœli & terræ: Hæretici inficiantes hoc, quocunque se fuco tegant, in alterutram ex his blasphemiis manifestissimis necessario incidunt, ut vel Deos & creatores plures constituant, vel à mundi creatione, veraque divinitate & æqualitate cum Patre & Filio Spir.S. removeant.
VII[?]. Fructus: Spiritus S. effusus est super omnem carnem: Ergo & super nos. Breviter per-stringantur beneficia Sp.S.
I. Omnes prophetant, visiones, somnia videt: quibus phrasibus oftende illustrem Dei cognitionem significari, sub tropis veteri testamento convenientibus.

page.notes: The Roman numeral before "Fructus" is hard to read and is given as VII with [?]. "Deos" is read from "D.os" in a damaged line. The reference "Jef." (printed "Ief." or "Icf.") is read as Isaiah; the printed form is uncertain. The page number is read as 598 from a worn "§98". The bottom-right "2.Re-" is taken as a catchword, which the rules place below the last line. The line "lib.2.de Spiritu..." at the top is set in smaller type and is treated as a footnote.
